operator_context: User reported done after guidance to sweep selected first DPI stage through 800, 1600, 4000, one Apply per value. The immediately preceding screenshot showed selected first-stage value 200 and second-stage checkbox unchecked.

analysis_window.scope_note: Historical totals are full-capture counts. Setting-change comparisons use this time window and separate startup matching.

decoded_configuration.method: Read Python source through ast.literal_eval of constants only; did not import/execute the controller or access hardware.

limitations: Data-stage candidate bytes are recorded in VirtualBox control-phase setup slots; full payload coverage is not established.
Actual optical DPI/pointer sensitivity was not measured independently.
Static decoder constants were read as AST literals, never imported or executed; other controller codes remain static-only unless separately captured.
Protocol coordinates are not proven physical memory addresses.
Original capture and metadata were preserved and no device write was sent by the analyst.
publication_note: Local VM names and host-assigned USB UUIDs are redacted; personal absolute paths are normalized. Capture hashes, packet evidence and findings are retained. Raw captures remain private.
